prompt: Design an 8-point 8-bit FFT module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit real input x_re, imaginary input x_im, and outputs: 8-bit real output y_re, imaginary output y_im. module_name is "fft_8pt_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, x_re[7:0], x_im[7:0]. output pin: y_re[7:0], y_im[7:0].

Design a 128-bit AES encryption core module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, start signal start, 128-bit plaintext p, 128-bit key k, and outputs: 128-bit ciphertext c and completion signal done. module_name is "aes_encrypt_128". input pin: clk, rst, start, p[127:0], k[127:0]. output pin: c[127:0], done.

Design a 4-input ascending order sorting module with input signals a, b, c, d of 4 bits each, and output the sorted signals ra, rb, rc, rd. module_name is "sort_asc_4". input pin: a[3:0], b[3:0], c[3:0], d[3:0]. output pin: ra[3:0], rb[3:0], rc[3:0], rd[3:0].

Design a 32-bit SPI master module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, transmit enable spi_en, 32-bit data din, and outputs: 1-bit serial data mosi, clock sclk, chip select cs. module_name is "spi_master_32bit". input pin: clk, rst, spi_en, din[31:0]. output pin: mosi, sclk, cs.

Design a 32-bit digital down-converter module with inputs: 1 clock signal clk, reset rst, 32-bit input signal x, and outputs: 32-bit I and Q components. module_name is "ddc_32bit". input pin: clk, rst, x[31:0]. output pin: i[31:0], q[31:0].

Design an 8x8-bit asynchronous FIFO module with input pins: write clock wclk, read clock rclk, reset rst, write enable wr, read enable rd, and 8-bit write data din. Output pins: 8-bit read data dout, empty flag empty, and full flag full. module_name is "async_fifo_8x8". input pin: wclk, rclk, rst, wr, rd, din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0], empty, full.

Design a 32-bit UART transmitter module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, transmit enable tx_en, 32-bit data din, and output: 1-bit serial data tx. module_name is "uart_tx_32bit". input pin: clk, rst, tx_en, din[31:0]. output pin: tx.

Design a 16-bit SPI master module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, transmit enable spi_en, 16-bit data din, and outputs: 1-bit serial data mosi, clock sclk, chip select cs. module_name is "spi_master_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, spi_en, din[15:0]. output pin: mosi, sclk, cs.
Design a 4:2 priority encoder module with a 4-bit input signal d, and outputs a 2-bit code y and a 1-bit valid signal v. module_name is "encoder_4to2". input pin: d[3:0]. output pin: y[1:0], v.

Design an OR gate clock gating module with a 1-bit clock input clk, enable input en, and a 1-bit gated clock output gclk, implemented using an OR gate. module_name is "or_clock_gating". input pin: clk, en. output pin: gclk.
Design a half adder module with two 1-bit input signals a and b, and output 1-bit sum s and carry c. module_name is "half_adder". input pin: a, b. output pin: s, c.

Design an 8-bit I2C master module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, start signal start, 8-bit data din, and output pins: serial data sda and clock scl. module_name is "i2c_master_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, start, din[7:0]. output pin: sda, scl.
Design a 16-bit ring counter module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset input rst, and a 16-bit output q. module_name is "ring_counter_16bit". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: q[15:0].

Design a smart fan controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit temperature value temp, 8-bit threshold thresh, and outputs: 1-bit fan switch fan_on, 2-bit fan speed speed. When temp > thresh, fan_on=1, and the speed is set based on the difference between temp and thresh (00: low speed, 01: medium speed, 10: high speed). When rst=1, the fan is turned off. module_name is "fan_controller". input pin: clk, rst, temp[7:0], thresh[7:0]. output pin: fan_on, speed[1:0].

Design a module to calculate the least common multiple of two numbers. Inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit unsigned numbers a and b. Output: least common multiple lcm_out. module_name is "lcm_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: lcm_out[15:0].

Design a 4-bit serial-in serial-out (SISO) shift register module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, data input si, and a 1-bit output so. module_name is "siso_shift_reg_4bit". input pin: clk, rst, si. output pin: so.

Design an asynchronous reset synchronous release module with a 1-bit clock input clk, an asynchronous reset input async_rst, and a 1-bit synchronous reset output sync_rst. module_name is "async_reset_sync_release". input pin: clk, async_rst. output pin: sync_rst.

Design a synchronous Moore-type state machine module to detect the sequence "110", with 1-bit input clk, rst, in, and 1-bit output out. module_name is "sync_fsm_110". input pin: clk, rst, in. output pin: out.

Design a 16-bit unsigned multi-cycle multiplier module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, start signal start, two 16-bit signals a and b, and output pins: 32-bit product p and completion signal done. module_name is "multicycle_multiplier_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, start, a[15:0], b[15:0]. output pin: p[31:0], done.

Design a single-precision floating-point addition unit module with two 32-bit IEEE754 floating-point numbers a and b as inputs, and a 32-bit result s as output. module_name is "fp_adder_32bit". input pin: a[31:0], b[31:0]. output pin: s[31:0].

Design an 8-point pipelined FFT module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit real part input x_re, imaginary part x_im, and outputs: 8-bit real part y_re, imaginary part y_im. module_name is "pipeline_fft_8pt". input pin: clk, rst, x_re[7:0], x_im[7:0]. output pin: y_re[7:0], y_im[7:0].

Design a simple CNN accelerator module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, start signal start, 8-bit input feature map ifm[3:0][3:0][7:0], 8-bit convolution kernel w[2:0][2:0][7:0], and 8-bit output feature map ofm[2:0][2:0][7:0]. Implement 2x2 convolution with a stride of 1. module_name is "cnn_accelerator". input pin: clk, rst, start, ifm[3:0][3:0][7:0], w[2:0][2:0][7:0]. output pin: ofm[2:0][2:0][7:0].

Design an 8-bit signed divider module with 8-bit dividend a and divisor b as inputs, and 8-bit quotient q and remainder r as outputs. module_name is "signed_divider_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: q[7:0], r[7:0].
Design a 32-bit OR gate module with two 32-bit input signals a and b, and a 32-bit output signal y. module_name is "or_gate_32bit". input pin: a[31:0], b[31:0]. output pin: y[31:0].

Design a triple modular redundancy (TMR) voter module with three 8-bit input signals a, b, c, and an 8-bit output y along with a 1-bit error flag err. y is the majority voting result of a, b, c, and err=1 indicates inconsistency among the three. module_name is "tmr_voter_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0], c[7:0]. output pin: y[7:0], err.

Design a 16-bit unsigned multi-cycle divider module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, start signal start, 16-bit dividend a, and divisor b. Output pins: 16-bit quotient q, remainder r, and completion signal done. module_name is "multicycle_divider_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, start, a[15:0], b[15:0]. output pin: q[15:0], r[15:0], done.

Design an 8x8-bit synchronous SRAM module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, write enable we, read enable re, 3-bit address addr, 8-bit write data din, and output pin: 8-bit read data dout. module_name is "sram_8x8". input pin: clk, we, re, addr[2:0], din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0].

Design a 16-bit UART transmitter module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, transmit enable tx_en, 16-bit data din, and output pin: 1-bit serial data tx. module_name is "uart_tx_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, tx_en, din[15:0]. output pin: tx.

Design a 32-bit unsigned Wallace tree multiplier module with two 32-bit input signals a and b, and a 64-bit product output p. module_name is "wallace_multiplier_32bit". input pin: a[31:0], b[31:0]. output pin: p[63:0].
Design a full subtractor module with three 1-bit inputs a, b, bin, and outputs 1-bit difference d and borrow bout. module_name is "full_subtractor". input pin: a, b, bin. output pin: d, bout.
Design an 8x8-bit ROM module with a 3-bit address input 'addr' and an 8-bit data output 'dout'. module_name is "rom_8x8". input pin: addr[2:0]. output pin: dout[7:0].

Design an 8-bit CRC-8 checksum module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, enable en, and 8-bit data d; output pin: 8-bit CRC code c. module_name is "crc8". input pin: clk, rst, en, d[7:0]. output pin: c[7:0].

Design a heart rate monitor module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit heartbeat pulse pulse, and outputs: 8-bit heart rate value bpm, 1-bit abnormal signal alert. Calculate the number of heartbeats per minute (bpm), and trigger alert when bpm<40 or bpm>120. module_name is "heart_rate_monitor". input pin: clk, rst, pulse. output pin: bpm[7:0], alert.
Design a synchronous JK flip-flop module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, j, k, and 1-bit output q. module_name is "jk_ff". input pin: clk, rst, j, k. output pin: q.

Design an automatic door controller module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, 1-bit sensor signal sensor, and outputs a 1-bit open signal open and a 1-bit close signal close. When sensor=1, the door opens for 5s and then closes. module_name is "auto_door_controller". input pin: clk, rst, sensor. output pin: open, close.

Design an AND gate clock gating module with a 1-bit clock input clk, enable input en, and a 1-bit gated clock output gclk, implemented using an AND gate. module_name is "and_clock_gating". input pin: clk, en. output pin: gclk.

Design a module to calculate the difference between two numbers. The inputs are 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, two 8-bit unsigned numbers a and b, and the output is the difference c. If a > b, output a - b; if a ≤ b, output b - a. module_name is "data_minus". input pin: clk, rst, a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: c[7:0].
Design an 8-bit binary to BCD converter module, with an 8-bit binary input b and a 12-bit BCD output d (3x4-bit BCD). module_name is "bin_to_bcd_8bit". input pin: b[7:0]. output pin: d[11:0].

Design a Moore-type finite state machine module to detect the sequence "101", with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, data input in, and 1-bit output out. module_name is "moore_fsm_101". input pin: clk, rst, in. output pin: out.

Design a taxi meter module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit start signal start, stop signal stop, 1-bit distance pulse dist_pulse, and outputs: fare, running status running. The fare rule is a starting price of 500 cents (within 2 kilometers), with an additional 100 cents per kilometer. When start=1, fare calculation begins, running=1, and initial fare=500; when stop=1, fare calculation stops, running=0. For each dist_pulse received (representing 1 kilometer), if the distance exceeds 2 kilometers, fare increases by 100 cents. When rst=1, the system resets with fare=0 and running=0. module_name is "simple_taxi_meter". input pins: clk, rst, start, stop, dist_pulse. output pins: fare[15:0], running.

Design a 16-bit pipelined CORDIC module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 16-bit angle z, and outputs: 16-bit sin and cos values. module_name is "pipelined_cordic_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, z[15:0]. output pin: sin[15:0], cos[15:0].

Design a 16-bit signed Booth multiplier module with two 16-bit signed inputs a and b, and a 32-bit product output p. module_name is "booth_multiplier_16bit". input pin: a[15:0], b[15:0]. output pin: p[31:0].
Design a BCH(15,11) encoder module with an 11-bit input data d and a 15-bit BCH code output c. module_name is "bch_encoder_15_11". input pin: d[10:0]. output pin: c[14:0].

Design a 16-bit CORDIC module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, and 16-bit angle z; outputs: 16-bit sin and cos values. module_name is "cordic_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, z[15:0]. output pin: sin[15:0], cos[15:0].

Design a single-bit synchronous reset module with a 1-bit clock input clk, asynchronous reset rst, data input d, and 1-bit output q. module_name is "reset_1bit". input pin: clk, rst, d. output pin: q.

Design a 4th-order low-pass FIR filter module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, 8-bit input x, and 8-bit output y. module_name is "fir_lowpass_4tap". input pin: clk, rst, x[7:0]. output pin: y[7:0].

Design a factory temperature monitoring system module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, and 8-bit temperature sensor data temp; outputs: 1-bit alarm signal alarm and 8-bit temperature value temp_out. The alarm is triggered when temp > 80°C, and temp_out records the latest temperature. module_name is "factory_temp_monitor". input pin: clk, rst, temp[7:0]. output pin: alarm, temp_out[7:0].
Design a 16-bit LFSR module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset input rst, and a 16-bit pseudo-random number output q. module_name is "lfsr_16bit". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: q[15:0].
Design a 32-bit unsigned integer square root module with a 32-bit input signal d and a 16-bit square root output s. module_name is "sqrt_32bit". input pin: d[31:0]. output pin: s[15:0].

Design an industrial assembly line controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit sensor signal sensor, 1-bit start signal start; outputs: 1-bit motor, 1-bit conveyor belt, 1-bit stop signal stop. When sensor=1, the assembly line starts; when abnormal, stop=1. module_name is "assembly_line_controller". input pin: clk, rst, sensor, start. output pin: motor, belt, stop.

Design a smart curtain controller module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, 1-bit light sensor input light, 1-bit manual switch input manual, and outputs a 1-bit open signal open and a 1-bit close signal close. When light=0 or manual=1, open is active; when light=1, close is active. module_name is "smart_curtain_controller". input pin: clk, rst, light, manual. output pin: open, close.
Design a 4-bit binary to Gray code converter module with input 4-bit binary number b and output 4-bit Gray code g. module_name is "bin_to_gray_4bit". input pin: b[3:0]. output pin: g[3:0].

Design a 4-bit parallel-in parallel-out (PIPO) shift register module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, load signal load, 4-bit parallel data d, and output: 4-bit q. module_name is "pipo_shift_reg_4bit". input pin: clk, rst, load, d[3:0]. output pin: q[3:0].

Design an 8-bit unsigned divider module with 8-bit dividend a and divisor b as inputs, and 8-bit quotient q and remainder r as outputs. module_name is "unsigned_divider_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: q[7:0], r[7:0].

Design a 4-bit BCD to 7-segment display converter module, with a 4-bit BCD input d and a 7-bit 7-segment display output seg (a-g). The corresponding segment lights up when the signal is low. module_name is "bcd_to_7seg". input pin: d[3:0]. output pin: seg[6:0].

Design a synchronous D flip-flop module with a 1-bit enable en, inputs including 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, data d, en, and output 1-bit q. module_name is "d_ff_en". input pin: clk, rst, d, en. output pin: q.
Design a NOT gate module with a 1-bit input signal a and a 1-bit output signal y. module_name is "not_gate". input pin: a. output pin: y.

Design a 1-bit comparator module with two 1-bit input signals a and b, and output a 3-bit signal gt, eq, lt, representing a>b, a=b, a<b respectively. module_name is "bit_comparator". input pin: a, b. output pin: gt, eq, lt.

Design a half-precision floating-point addition unit module with two 16-bit IEEE754 floating-point inputs a and b, and a 16-bit output s. module_name is "fp_adder_16bit". input pin: a[15:0], b[15:0]. output pin: s[15:0].

Design an 8-bit magnitude comparator module with two 8-bit input signals a and b, and output a 3-bit signal gt, eq, lt, representing a>b, a=b, a<b respectively. module_name is "mag_comparator_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: gt, eq, lt.

Design a 4-stage pipelined 16-bit adder module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, two 16-bit signals a and b, and output: 16-bit sum s. module_name is "pipelined_adder_16bit_4stage". input pin: clk, rst, a[15:0], b[15:0]. output pin: s[15:0].
Design a 2-input NOR gate module with two 1-bit input signals a and b, and a 1-bit output signal y. module_name is "nor_gate". input pin: a, b. output pin: y.
Design a 32-bit AND gate module with two 32-bit input signals a and b, and a 32-bit output signal y. module_name is "and_gate_32bit". input pin: a[31:0], b[31:0]. output pin: y[31:0].

Design a temperature sensor interface module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit sensor data sensor_data, and output: 8-bit temperature value temp. sensor_data is serial input, with 8-bit data representing 0-255°C. module_name is "temp_sensor_interface". input pin: clk, rst, sensor_data. output pin: temp[7:0].

Design an 8-bit digital down-converter module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit input signal x, and outputs: 8-bit I and Q components. module_name is "ddc_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, x[7:0]. output pin: i[7:0], q[7:0].

Design a 32-bit 2:1 multiplexer module with two 32-bit input data signals d0 and d1, a 1-bit selection signal sel, and a 32-bit output signal y. module_name is "mux_2to1_32bit". input pin: d0[31:0], d1[31:0], sel. output pin: y[31:0].

Design an 8-bit synchronous reset module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, asynchronous reset rst, 8-bit data d, and output: 8-bit q. module_name is "reset_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, d[7:0]. output pin: q[7:0].

Design an 8-bit I2C slave module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, serial data sda, and clock scl; output pin: 8-bit data dout. module_name is "i2c_slave_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, sda, scl. output pin: dout[7:0].

Design an 8-point 16-bit FFT module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 16-bit real input x_re, imaginary input x_im, and outputs: 16-bit real output y_re, imaginary output y_im. module_name is "fft_8pt_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, x_re[15:0], x_im[15:0]. output pin: y_re[15:0], y_im[15:0].

Design a Mealy-type finite state machine module to detect the sequence "101", with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, data in, and output: 1-bit out. module_name is "mealy_fsm_101". input pin: clk, rst, in. output pin: out.

Design an IoT node controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit sensor trigger sensor, 1-bit transmit enable tx_en, and outputs: 1-bit data tx, 1-bit sleep signal sleep. When sensor=1, collect and transmit data, then enter sleep mode after completion. module_name is "iot_node_controller". input pin: clk, rst, sensor, tx_en. output pin: tx, sleep.

Design a single pulse generator module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit trigger signal trigger, and output pin: pulse. module_name is "single_pulse_generator". input pin: clk, rst, trigger. output pin: pulse.
Design a 2-input OR gate module with two 1-bit input signals a and b, and a 1-bit output signal y. module_name is "or_gate". input pin: a, b. output pin: y.
Design a decimal to BCD encoder module with a 4-bit decimal input d (0-9) and a 4-bit BCD output y. module_name is "dec_to_bcd". input pin: d[3:0]. output pin: y[3:0].

Design a smart door lock controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 4-bit password input pass, 1-bit unlock request unlock; outputs: 1-bit unlock signal open, 1-bit error signal error. When pass matches the preset password (4’b1010), open=1; three consecutive incorrect attempts trigger error. module_name is "smart_door_lock". input pin: clk, rst, pass[3:0], unlock. output pin: open, error.
Design a 2-divider module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, and 1-bit divided clock output clk_out. module_name is "div2". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: clk_out.

Design a 4-floor elevator controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 4-bit floor request floor_req, 2-bit current floor cur_floor, and outputs: 1-bit door switch door, 2-bit target floor next_floor, 1-bit movement direction dir (1=up, 0=down). Move to the target floor based on requests, where door=1 indicates the door is open. module_name is "elevator_controller_4floor". input pin: clk, rst, floor_req[3:0], cur_floor[1:0]. output pin: door, next_floor[1:0], dir.

Design an 8x8-bit synchronous DRAM module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, write enable we, read enable re, 3-bit address addr, 8-bit write data din, and output pin: 8-bit read data dout. module_name is "dram_8x8". input pin: clk, we, re, addr[2:0], din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0].
Design a synchronous T flip-flop module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, and t, and 1-bit output q. module_name is "t_ff". input pin: clk, rst, t. output pin: q.

Design a parking lot management module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit vehicle entry enter, 1-bit vehicle exit exit, and outputs: 4-bit remaining parking space count, 1-bit full flag full. The parking lot capacity is 10 vehicles. enter=1 increases the vehicle count, exit=1 decreases the vehicle count, and count displays the remaining spaces. module_name is "parking_lot_manager". input pin: clk, rst, enter, exit. output pin: count[3:0], full.
Design an asynchronous state machine module to detect the sequence "11", with a 1-bit input 'in' and a 1-bit output 'out'. module_name is "async_fsm_11". input pin: in. output pin: out.
Design a 3-divider module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, and 1-bit divided clock output clk_out. module_name is "div3". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: clk_out.
Design a 1.5 frequency divider module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, and a 1-bit output divided clock clk_out. module_name is "div1_5". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: clk_out.

Design a 32-bit 4:1 multiplexer module with four 32-bit inputs d0, d1, d2, d3, a 2-bit select signal sel, and a 32-bit output y. module_name is "mux_4to1_32bit". input pin: d0[31:0], d1[31:0], d2[31:0], d3[31:0], sel. output pin: y[31:0].
Design a 4-bit Gray code counter module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, enable en, and a 4-bit output q. module_name is "gray_counter_4bit". input pin: clk, rst, en. output pin: q[3:0].

Design an 8-bit cross-clock domain data transfer module with input pins: write clock wclk, read clock rclk, reset rst, 8-bit write data din[7:0], write enable wr; output pins: 8-bit read data dout[7:0], read valid rd_valid. module_name is "cdc_data_transfer_8bit".
Design a 4-bit Johnson counter module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset input rst, and a 4-bit output q. module_name is "johnson_counter_4bit". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: q[3:0].
Design a 3:8 decoder module with a 3-bit input signal d and an 8-bit output signal y. module_name is "decoder_3to8". input pin: d[2:0]. output pin: y[7:0].

Design a water pump controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit water level sensor water_level, 1-bit manual switch manual, and output: 1-bit pump switch pump. The pump is activated when water_level=0 or manual=1. module_name is "water_pump_controller". input pin: clk, rst, water_level, manual. output pin: pump.

Design a 4-bit unsigned combinational logic multiplier module with two 4-bit input signals a and b, and an 8-bit output result p. module_name is "comb_multiplier_4bit". input pin: a[3:0], b[3:0]. output pin: p[7:0].

Design a data endianness conversion module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, two 4-bit unsigned numbers a and b, and outputs the converted data c and d. module_name is "endian_conver". input pin: clk, rst, a[3:0], b[3:0]. output pin: c[3:0], d[3:0].
Design an 8-bit Gray code to binary converter module, input 8-bit Gray code g, output 8-bit binary b. module_name is "gray_to_bin_8bit". input pin: g[7:0]. output pin: b[7:0].
Design a full adder module with three 1-bit inputs a, b, cin, and outputs 1-bit sum s and carry cout. module_name is "full_adder". input pin: a, b, cin. output pin: s, cout.
Design a 12-bit Hamming code encoder module with an 8-bit input data d and a 12-bit Hamming code output c. module_name is "hamming_encoder_12bit". input pin: d[7:0]. output pin: c[11:0].
Design a 2:1 multiplexer module with two 1-bit data inputs d0 and d1, a 1-bit select signal sel, and a 1-bit output y. module_name is "mux_2to1". input pin: d0, d1, sel. output pin: y.
Design a 4:1 multiplexer module with four 1-bit inputs d0, d1, d2, d3, a 2-bit select signal sel, and a 1-bit output y. module_name is "mux_4to1". input pin: d0, d1, d2, d3, sel[1:0]. output pin: y.

Design a SHA-256 hash module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, start signal start, 512-bit input data d; output pins: 256-bit hash value h and completion signal done. module_name is "sha256". input pin: clk, rst, start, d[511:0]. output pin: h[255:0], done.

Design a smart rice cooker controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 2-bit mode (cook, keep warm, porridge), 1-bit start signal start; outputs: 1-bit heater, 1-bit keep_warm, 1-bit done signal. module_name is "rice_cooker_controller". input pin: clk, rst, mode[1:0], start. output pin: heater, keep_warm, done.

Design an 8x8-bit ring FIFO module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, write enable wr, read enable rd, and 8-bit write data din. Outputs: 8-bit read data dout, 1-bit empty flag empty, and full flag full. module_name is "ring_fifo_8x8". input pin: clk, rst, wr, rd, din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0], empty, full.
Design a 4-bit decimal counter module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, enable en, and a 4-bit output q (0-9). module_name is "bcd_counter_4bit". input pin: clk, rst, en. output pin: q[3:0].
Design a clock gating module with a 1-bit clock input clk, enable input en, and a 1-bit gated clock output gclk. module_name is "clock_gating". input pin: clk, en. output pin: gclk.

Design an edge detection module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, and 1-bit signal a. The output rise=1 when a rising edge is detected, down=1 when a falling edge is detected, and 0 at all other times. module_name is "edge_detect". input pin: clk, rst, a. output pin: rise, down.

Design a 16-bit digital down-converter module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 16-bit input signal x, and outputs: 16-bit I and Q components. module_name is "ddc_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, x[15:0]. output pin: i[15:0], q[15:0].

Design an 8-bit CORDIC module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, and 8-bit angle z; outputs: 8-bit sin and cos values. module_name is "cordic_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, z[7:0]. output pin: sin[7:0], cos[7:0].
Design a 1:4 demultiplexer module with a 1-bit enable signal. module_name is "demux_1to4_en". input pin: d, sel[1:0], en. output pin: y[3:0].

Design an 8x8-bit dual-port synchronous FIFO module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, write enable wr, read enable rd, and 8-bit write data din. Output pins: 8-bit read data dout, 1-bit empty flag empty, and full flag full. module_name is "dualport_fifo_8x8". input pin: clk, rst, wr, rd, din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0], empty, full.

Design a basic handshake module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, request req, and 8-bit data din; outputs: 1-bit acknowledgment ack and 8-bit data dout. module_name is "handshake". input pin: clk, rst, req, din[7:0]. output pin: ack, dout[7:0].

Design a 16-bit unsigned restoring division module with 16-bit dividend a and divisor b as inputs, and 16-bit quotient q and remainder r as outputs. module_name is "restoring_divider_16bit". input pin: a[15:0], b[15:0]. output pin: q[15:0], r[15:0].
Design an 8-bit parity checker module with an 8-bit input d and a 1-bit odd parity output p. module_name is "parity_checker_8bit". input pin:d[7:0]. output pin:p.

Design a 4-bit parallel-in serial-out (PISO) shift register module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, load signal load, 4-bit parallel data d, and output: 1-bit so. module_name is "piso_shift_reg_4bit". input pin: clk, rst, load, d[3:0]. output pin: so.

Design an 8-bit CRC-16 checksum module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, enable en, and 8-bit data d; output: 16-bit CRC code c. module_name is "crc16". input pin: clk, rst, en, d[7:0]. output pin: c[15:0].

Design a two-stage flip-flop synchronizer module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, and asynchronous data input d, and a 1-bit synchronized data output q. module_name is "two_stage_synchronizer". input pin: clk, rst, d. output pin: q.

Design a double-precision floating-point addition unit module, input two 64-bit IEEE754 floating-point numbers a and b, output 64-bit result s. module_name is "fp_adder_64bit". input pin: a[63:0], b[63:0]. output pin: s[63:0].

Design an 8-bit RISC processor ALU module with 8-bit input operands a and b, a 3-bit opcode op, and outputs an 8-bit result y and 4 flags z (zero), n (negative), c (carry), v (overflow). module_name is "risc_alu_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0], op[2:0]. output pin: y[7:0], z, n, c, v.

Design a 4-bit up/down counter module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, enable en, up/down control up_down, and output 4-bit q. module_name is "up_down_counter_4bit". input pin: clk, rst, en, up_down. output pin: q[3:0].

Design a step counter controller module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, 1-bit step sensor step, and outputs a 16-bit step count count and a 1-bit goal achievement signal goal. The daily goal is 10000 steps. Count when step=1, and goal=1 indicates the goal is achieved. module_name is "pedometer_controller". input pin: clk, rst, step. output pin: count[15:0], goal.
Design a 2-input XOR gate module with two 1-bit input signals a and b, and a 1-bit output signal y. module_name is "xor_gate". input pin: a, b. output pin: y.
Design a synchronous D flip-flop module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, data input d, and 1-bit output q. module_name is "d_ff". input pin: clk, rst, d. output pin: q.

Design a 16-bit carry lookahead adder module, with inputs of two 16-bit signals a and b and a 1-bit carry input cin, and outputs of a 16-bit sum s and a 1-bit carry output cout. module_name is "cla_adder_16bit". input pin: a[15:0], b[15:0], cin. output pin: s[15:0], cout.
Design a synchronous SR flip-flop module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, s, r, and 1-bit output q. module_name is "sr_ff". input pin: clk, rst, s, r. output pin: q.

Design an 8-bit UART transmitter module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, transmit enable tx_en, 8-bit data din, and output pin: 1-bit serial data tx. module_name is "uart_tx_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, tx_en, din[7:0]. output pin: tx.

Design a 4-input round-robin arbiter module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 4-bit request req, and outputs: 4-bit grant gnt. module_name is "round_robin_arbiter_4". input pin: clk, rst, req[3:0]. output pin: gnt[3:0].
Design a 1:16 demultiplexer module with 1-bit input data d, 4-bit select signal sel, and 16-bit output signal y. module_name is "demux_1to16". input pin: d, sel[3:0]. output pin: y[15:0].

Design a smart smoke alarm module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit smoke sensor smoke, 1-bit disarm signal disarm, and outputs: 1-bit alarm signal alarm, 1-bit warning signal warning. When smoke=1 persists for 5 clock cycles, warning=1; when it persists for 10 cycles, alarm=1. All outputs are cleared when disarm=1. module_name is "smoke_detector_controller". input pin: clk, rst, smoke, disarm. output pin: alarm, warning.
Design a half subtractor module with two 1-bit inputs a and b, and outputs the 1-bit difference d and borrow bout. module_name is "half_subtractor". input pin: a, b. output pin: d, bout

Design a 4-input descending order sorting module with input signals a, b, c, d (4-bit each), and output sorted signals ra, rb, rc, rd. module_name is "sort_desc_4". input pin: a[3:0], b[3:0], c[3:0], d[3:0]. output pin: ra[3:0], rb[3:0], rc[3:0], rd[3:0].
Design a 4-input AND gate module with four 1-bit input signals a, b, c, d, and one 1-bit output signal y. module_name is "and_gate_4input". input pin: a, b, c, d. output pin: y.

Design a single-precision floating-point multiplier module that takes two 32-bit IEEE 754 floating-point numbers a and b as input and outputs a 32-bit result p. module_name is "fp_multiplier_32bit". input pin: a[31:0], b[31:0]. output pin: p[31:0].

Design a 12-bit Hamming code decoder module with input 12-bit Hamming code c, output 8-bit data d, and 1-bit error flag err. module_name is "hamming_decoder_12bit". input pin: c[11:0]. output pin: d[7:0], err.

Design a 4-bit unsigned array multiplier module with two 4-bit input signals a and b, and an 8-bit output result p. module_name is "array_multiplier_4bit". input pin: a[3:0], b[3:0]. output pin: p[7:0].
Design a 2-input XNOR gate module with two 1-bit input signals a and b, and a 1-bit output signal y. module_name is "xnor_gate". input pin: a, b. output pin: y.

Design a vending machine controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 2-bit coin input signal coin (00=none, 01=1 yuan, 10=2 yuan), 2-bit item selection item_sel; outputs: 1-bit dispense signal dispense, 2-bit change signal change. The item prices are 3 yuan and 5 yuan respectively. Dispense the item and provide change when sufficient coins are inserted. module_name is "vend_controller". input pin: clk, rst, coin[1:0], item_sel[1:0]. output pin: dispense, change[1:0].

Design a telephone billing module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit call start signal start, call end signal stop, and outputs: cost, call status active. Billing rules: Charge 30 cents per minute (60 seconds), with any fraction of a minute rounded up to a full minute. When start=1, billing begins, active=1, initial cost=30 (first-minute fee); every 60 seconds, cost increases by 30 cents. When stop=1, billing stops, active=0, cost remains unchanged. When rst=1, reset occurs, cost=0, active=0. module_name is "phone_billing". input pin: clk, rst, start, stop. output pin: cost[15:0], active.

Design a module to calculate the greatest common divisor of two numbers, with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit unsigned numbers a and b, and output: greatest common divisor mcd_out. module_name is "mcd_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: mcd_out[15:0].

Design an 8-bit GPIO module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit direction control dir, 8-bit data din, and output: 8-bit data dout, connected to 8-bit io pins. module_name is "gpio_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, dir[7:0], din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0]. inout: io[7:0].
Design an 8-bit equality comparator module with two 8-bit input signals a and b, and a 1-bit output signal eq. module_name is "eq_comparator_8bit". input pin: a[7:0], b[7:0]. output pin: eq.
Design a 2:4 decoder module with a 1-bit enable signal en, 2-bit input signal d, and 4-bit output signal y. module_name is "decoder_2to4_en". input pin: d[1:0], en. output pin: y[3:0].
Design a 1:8 demultiplexer module with 1-bit input data d, 3-bit select signal sel, and 8-bit output signal y. module_name is "demux_1to8". input pin: d, sel[2:0]. output pin: y[7:0].

Design a 16-bit watchdog timer module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, enable en, and a 1-bit timeout flag output. module_name is "watchdog_16bit". input pin: clk, rst, en. output pin: timeout.

Design a smart home lighting controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit manual switch switch, 1-bit light sensor light_sensor, and outputs: 1-bit light switch light_on, 3-bit brightness level. When switch=1, manual control is enabled; when light_sensor=1, level is automatically adjusted (0-7). module_name is "smart_light_controller". input pin: clk, rst, switch, light_sensor. output pin: light_on, level[2:0].
Design a 4:16 decoder module with a 4-bit input signal d and a 16-bit output signal y. module_name is "decoder_4to16". input pin: d[3:0]. output pin: y[15:0].
Design an RS(15,11) Reed-Solomon encoder module with 11-bit input data d and 15-bit RS code output c. module_name is "rs_encoder_15_11". input pin: d[10:0]. output pin: c[14:0].

Design a 3-stage 8-bit pipeline register module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 8-bit data din, and output pin: 8-bit data dout. module_name is "pipeline_reg_3stage_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0].
Design a 4-input fixed priority arbiter module with a 4-bit request input req and a 4-bit grant output gnt. module_name is "fixed_priority_arbiter_4". input pin: req[3:0]. output pin: gnt[3:0].

Design a single-bit GPIO module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, direction control dir, data input din, and a 1-bit data output dout connected to the io pin. module_name is "gpio_1bit". input pin: clk, rst, dir, din. output pin: dout. inout: io.

Design a subway ticket controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 2-bit ticket price ticket (1-3 yuan), 2-bit coin input coin (00=none, 01=1 yuan, 10=2 yuan), and outputs: 1-bit gate opening signal gate, 1-bit change signal change. The gate opens and change is given when sufficient coins are inserted. module_name is "subway_ticket_controller". input pin: clk, rst, ticket[1:0], coin[1:0]. output pin: gate, change.

Design an 8x8-bit synchronous FIFO module with input pins: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, write enable wr, read enable rd, and 8-bit write data din. Output pins: 8-bit read data dout, 1-bit empty flag empty, and full flag full. module_name is "sync_fifo_8x8". input pin: clk, rst, wr, rd, din[7:0]. output pin: dout[7:0], empty, full.

Design a sequence generator module to cyclically output the sequence 001011, with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset input rst, and output data. module_name is "sequence_generator". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: data[5:0].

Design a traffic light controller module with a 1-bit clock input clk, reset input rst, and 3-bit outputs red, yellow, green. module_name is "traffic_light". input pin: clk, rst. output pin: red, yellow, green.

Design an automatic irrigation controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit soil moisture sensor moisture, 1-bit manual switch manual, and output: 1-bit irrigation switch irrigate. Irrigation starts for 10s when moisture=0 or manual=1. module_name is "irrigation_controller". input pin: clk, rst, moisture, manual. output pin: irrigate.
Design a 1:4 demultiplexer module with 1-bit input data d, 2-bit select signal sel, and 4-bit output signal y. module_name is "demux_1to4". input pin: d, sel[1:0]. output pin: y[3:0].

Design a 4-bit Gray code cross-clock domain synchronizer module with input source clock sclk, destination clock dclk, reset rst, 4-bit Gray code input gin, and output 4-bit synchronized Gray code gout. module_name is "gray_code_synchronizer_4bit". input pin: sclk, dclk, rst, gin[3:0]. output pin: gout[3:0].
Design an 8-bit binary counter module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, enable en, and output: 8-bit q. module_name is "binary_counter_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, en. output pin: q[7:0].

Design an 8-bit SPI master module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, transmit enable spi_en, and 8-bit data din; outputs: 1-bit serial data mosi, clock sclk, and chip select cs. module_name is "spi_master_8bit". input pin: clk, rst, spi_en, din[7:0]. output pin: mosi, sclk, cs.

Design a digital clock controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit set signal set, 2-bit adjustment signal adj (adjust hour/minute), and outputs: 8-bit hour hour, minute minute (BCD). Implement a 24-hour format, adjust time when set=1. module_name is "digital_clock_controller". input pin: clk, rst, set, adj[1:0]. output pin: hour[7:0], minute[7:0].

Design a 4th-order highpass FIR filter module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, 8-bit input x, and 8-bit output y. module_name is "fir_highpass_4tap". input pin: clk, rst, x[7:0]. output pin: y[7:0].
Design an 8:3 priority encoder module with an 8-bit input signal d, and outputs a 3-bit code y and a 1-bit valid signal v. module_name is "encoder_8to3". input pin: d[7:0]. output pin: y[2:0], v.

Design a security alarm system module with 1-bit clock input clk, reset rst, 1-bit sensor signal sensor, 1-bit disarm signal disarm, and 1-bit alarm output alarm. The alarm is triggered when sensor=1 unless disarm=1. module_name is "security_alarm". input pin: clk, rst, sensor, disarm. output pin: alarm.

Design a washing machine controller module with inputs: 1-bit clock clk, reset rst, 1-bit start signal start, 2-bit mode signal mode, and outputs: 1-bit wash, rinse, spin. Supports three modes (quick, standard, strong). module_name is "washing_machine_controller". input pin: clk, rst, start, mode[1:0]. output pin: wash, rinse, spin.
Design a 2:4 decoder module with a 2-bit input signal d and a 4-bit output signal y. module_name is "decoder_2to4". input pin: d[1:0]. output pin: y[3:0].
